description: Fee ON → place a wind order with a Stripe PREPAID test card. Surcharging debit/prepaid is barred, so finalize-surcharge drops the fee before the charge: the stored order has processingFee 0 and a total below the credit quote.

steps.name: finalize-surcharge must succeed — on failure the checkout falls through and charges the quoted (credit) amount

Fee removed: the lower total is shown, then a second tap pays it
